actions.reason: K6_C0002 has a coherent, interpretable biological identity (coordinated immune/inflammatory down-regulation with oxidative phosphorylation and fatty-acid metabolism up; ER:0642ea974835:biological_support:rna_pathway_enrichment:set:022d0ec422). Its current membership is positively represented in native patient geometry, with positive silhouettes in all four modalities and within-set distances below between-set distances in every modality (ER:0642ea974835:cross_modal_consistency:affinity_geometry_concordance:set:022d0ec422), and its boundary with K6_C0003 is expressed with positive silhouettes across all four modalities (ER:0642ea974835:cross_modal_consistency:affinity_geometry_concordance:pair:251a860358). This directly supports treating the current membership as an independent unit.

Its current membership is positively represented in native patient geometry, with positive silhouettes in all four modalities and within-set distances below between-set distances in every modality (ER:0642ea974835:cross_modal_consistency:affinity_geometry_concordance:set:1127836987). This directly supports treating the current membership as an independent unit.

K6_C0001 has an interpretable biological identity (proliferative program with oxidative phosphorylation down; ER:0642ea974835:biological_support:rna_pathway_enrichment:set:b8656a7616), but evidence directly bearing on its membership does not support independent retention. The pair boundary is essentially zero in fused affinity geometry (ER:0642ea974835:cross_modal_consistency:structural_diagnostics:pair:943649b4c5). With membership independence unsupported and no warranted structural revision, drop is appropriate.
